30031.label: Philemon 1:1
30031.text: Paul, a prisoner for the sake of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Phi·leʹmon our beloved fellow worker,

30032.label: Philemon 1:2
30032.text: and to Apʹphi·a our sister, and to Ar·chipʹpus our fellow soldier, and to the congregation that is in your house:

30033.label: Philemon 1:3
30033.text: May you have undeserved kindness and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

30034.label: Philemon 1:4
30034.text: I always thank my God when I mention you in my prayers,

30035.label: Philemon 1:5
30035.text: as I keep hearing of your faith and the love that you have for the Lord Jesus and for all the holy ones.

30036.label: Philemon 1:6
30036.text: I pray that your sharing in the faith may move you to acknowledge every good thing that we have through Christ.

30037.label: Philemon 1:7
30037.text: For I received much joy and comfort on hearing of your love, because the hearts of the holy ones have been refreshed through you, brother.

30038.label: Philemon 1:8
30038.text: For this very reason, though I have great freeness of speech in connection with Christ to order you to do what is proper,

30039.label: Philemon 1:9
30039.text: I would rather appeal to you on the basis of love, seeing that I am Paul an older man, yes, now also a prisoner for the sake of Christ Jesus.

30040.label: Philemon 1:10
30040.text: I am appealing to you for my child, whose father I became while in prison, O·nesʹi·mus.

30041.label: Philemon 1:11
30041.text: He was formerly useless to you, but now he is useful to you and to me.

30042.label: Philemon 1:12
30042.text: I am sending him back to you, yes him, my very own heart.

30043.label: Philemon 1:13
30043.text: I would like to keep him here for myself so that he might take your place in ministering to me during my imprisonment for the sake of the good news.

30044.label: Philemon 1:14
30044.text: But I do not want to do anything without your consent, so that your good deed may be done, not under compulsion, but of your own free will.

30045.label: Philemon 1:15
30045.text: Perhaps this is really why he broke away for a short while, so that you may have him back forever,

30046.label: Philemon 1:16
30046.text: no longer as a slave, but as more than a slave, as a brother who is beloved, especially so to me, but how much more so to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

30047.label: Philemon 1:17
30047.text: So if you consider me a friend, receive him kindly the same way you would me.

30048.label: Philemon 1:18
30048.text: Moreover, if he did you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to my account.

30049.label: Philemon 1:19
30049.text: I, Paul, am writing with my own hand: I will pay it back—not to mention that you owe me even your own self.

30050.label: Philemon 1:20
30050.text: Yes, brother, may I receive this assistance from you in connection with the Lord; refresh my heart in connection with Christ.

30051.label: Philemon 1:21
30051.text: I am confident that you will comply, so I am writing you, knowing that you will do even more than what I say.

30052.label: Philemon 1:22
30052.text: But along with that, also prepare a place for me to stay, for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given back to you.

30053.label: Philemon 1:23
30053.text: Sending you greetings is Epʹa·phras, my fellow captive in union with Christ Jesus,

30054.label: Philemon 1:24
30054.text: also Mark, Ar·is·tarʹchus, Deʹmas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

30055.label: Philemon 1:25
30055.text: The undeserved kindness of the Lord Jesus Christ be with the spirit you show.
